svg.aria-label: CareCompass v2 system overview: a member's message goes from the web app to the API, through a deterministic safety gate, to the Health Navigator agent team (a supervisor and four specialists split across OpenAI and Anthropic) which uses tools and outside services; journey memory, observability and an eval gate run underneath every request.
svg.text: System overview · the main components and how a member's request moves through them
Plans the care journey and delegates to subagents
Final check before anything reaches the member
Anthropic: Supervisor · Prepare the visit · Explain the diagnosis
Plan and progress persist across sessions
